title: Meeting a new classmate
context: It is your first day in a new class. A classmate says hello.

a.speaker: Sam
a.say: Hi! I am Sam. What is your name?

choices.text: Hi, Sam. I am Amina. Nice to meet you.
choices.feedback: Friendly and complete.
choices.textSo: Salaan, Sam. Magacaygu waa Amina. Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulmo.
choices.feedbackSo: Jawaab saaxiibtinimo leh oo dhammaystiran.

choices.feedback: Correct, but add a greeting to sound friendly.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa sax, laakiin salaanta ku dar si hadalkaagu u noqdo mid saaxiibtinimo leh.

choices.text: Why do you want to know?
choices.feedback: This sounds unfriendly when someone says hello.
choices.feedbackSo: Tani waxay u muuqanaysaa jawaab aan saaxiibtinimo lahayn marka qof ku salaamo.

a.saySo: Salaan! Magacaygu waa Sam. Adiguna magacaa?

b.speaker: Sam
b.say: Nice to meet you, Amina. Where are you from?

choices.text: I am from Somalia. And you?
choices.feedback: Good answer, and you asked a question back.
choices.feedbackSo: Jawaab wanaagsan ayaad bixisay, su’aalna dib ayaad u weydiisay.

choices.feedback: Correct. A full sentence is better.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa sax. Weedh dhammaystiran ayaa ka fiican.

choices.feedback: Try to say where you are from.
choices.feedbackSo: Isku day inaad sheegto meesha aad ka timid.

b.saySo: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulmo, Amina. Xaggee baad ka timid?

b2.speaker: Sam
b2.say: Oh, sorry. I only wanted to say hello.

choices.text: That is OK. I am Amina. Nice to meet you.
choices.feedback: A kind way to fix the moment.
choices.textSo: Waa hagaag. Magacaygu waa Amina. Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulmo.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa hab wanaagsan oo aad xaaladda ku hagaajin karto.

choices.feedback: A short sound does not help the conversation.
choices.feedbackSo: Cod gaaban wax badan kama tarayo sii wadidda wada sheekaysiga.

b2.saySo: Haye, iga raalli ahow. Waxaan doonayay oo keliya inaan ku salaamo.

e2.speaker: Sam
e2.saySo: Hagaag. Mar dambe ayaan is arki doonnaa.

contextSo: Waa maalintaadii koowaad ee fasal cusub. Arday kula dhigta ayaa ku salaamaya.

title: Ordering a drink at a café
context: You are at a café and want a tea.

choices.feedback: Polite and clear.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa edeb badan tahay, waana cadahay.

choices.feedback: Understood, but add "please".
choices.feedbackSo: Waa la fahmay, laakiin ku dar “fadlan”.

choices.feedback: This is too direct and not polite.
choices.feedbackSo: Tani waa hadal amar ah oo aan edeb lahayn.

choices.feedback: Short and polite.
choices.feedbackSo: Jawaab gaaban oo edeb leh.

choices.feedback: Fine. Add "please".
choices.feedbackSo: Waa hagaag. Ku dar “fadlan”.

choices.feedback: This does not answer the question.
choices.feedbackSo: Tani kama jawaabayso su’aasha.

b2.speaker: Waiter
b2.say: Sorry? Could you ask again, please?

choices.feedback: A good, polite repair.
choices.textSo: Waan ka xumahay. Shaah ayaan rabaa, fadlan.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa hab wanaagsan oo edeb leh oo aad hadalka ku saxdo.

choices.feedback: This ends the conversation badly.
choices.feedbackSo: Tani waxay wada sheekaysiga ku dhamaynaysaa si aan wanaagsanayn.

b2.saySo: Waan ka xumahay? Ma ku celin kartaa codsigaaga, fadlan?

choices.feedback: Natural when you pay.
choices.feedbackSo: Tani waa hadal dabiici ah markaad lacag bixinayso.

choices.feedback: Acceptable, but add thanks.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa la aqbali karaa, laakiin mahadnaq ku dar.

choices.feedback: Rude when the price is fair.
choices.feedbackSo: Tani waa hadal qallafsan marka qiimuhu macquul yahay.

contextSo: Waxaad joogtaa maqaaxi, waxaadna doonaysaa inaad shaah dalbato.

title: Disagreeing with a senior colleague
context: A senior director proposes cutting the training budget. You believe this is a mistake and need to say so without damaging the relationship.

a.speaker: Director
a.say: I think we should cut the training budget entirely this year. It is the easiest saving available.

choices.text: I appreciate the pressure on costs, and I wonder whether we might look at the longer-term picture before we decide.
choices.feedback: Acknowledges the concern, then reframes diplomatically.
choices.textSo: Waan fahmay cadaadiska kharashka, waxaana is weydiinayaa inay habboon tahay inaan eegno saamaynta muddada dheer ka hor go’aanka.
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu aqoonsaday walaaca, dabadeedna si diblomaasiyadeed ayuu arrinta u qaabeeyey.

choices.feedback: Blunt disagreement with a senior colleague closes the discussion.
choices.feedbackSo: Diidmo toos ahi waxay xidhaysaa wada-hadalka qof kaa sarreeya.

choices.text: If that is what you think best, I will go along with it.
choices.feedback: Avoids conflict but gives up your point.
choices.textSo: Haddii aad sidaas u aragto, waan kugu raacayaa.
choices.feedbackSo: Khilaafka wuu ka fogaanayaa, balse aragtidiisa ayuu ka tanaasulayaa.

a.saySo: Waxaan qabaa inaan sannadkan gebi ahaanba jarno miisaaniyadda tababarka. Taasi waa meesha ugu fudud ee kharashka laga dhimi karo.

b1.speaker: Director
b1.say: Go on. What are you worried about?

choices.text: Our attrition figures suggest that untrained staff leave sooner, so the saving may prove false economy. Might a reduced programme be a fair compromise?
choices.feedback: Evidence plus a constructive alternative.
choices.textSo: Tirakoobka shaqaalaha naga taga wuxuu muujinayaa in shaqaalaha aan la tababarin ay dhaqso u baxaan; sidaas darteed kaydku wuxuu noqon karaa khasaaro dambe. Ma noqon karaa barnaamij la dhimay tanaasul cadaalad ah?
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu keenayaa caddayn iyo xal kale oo wax dhisaya.

choices.feedback: A vague appeal is easy to dismiss.
choices.textSo: Qof walba wuu og yahay in tababarku muhiim yahay.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa dood guud oo si fudud loo diidi karo.

choices.text: I simply feel uneasy about it.
choices.feedback: Honest but lacks substance.
choices.textSo: Kaliya waxaan dareemayaa inaan arrintan ku qanacsanayn.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa daacad, balse caddayn ma laha.

b2.speaker: Director
b2.say: I beg your pardon? I would like to hear your reasoning, if you have any.

choices.text: That came across more sharply than I intended. My concern is that the savings may be short-lived, and I would like to explain why.
choices.feedback: A gracious recovery that keeps your argument alive.
choices.textSo: Hadalkaasi si ka adag intii aan ula jeeday ayuu u dhacay. Walaacaygu waa in kaydku muddo gaaban oo keliya jiri karo; waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan sababta sharxo.
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu si xushmad leh u saxayaa hadalkiisa, dooddiisana wuu sii wadaa.

choices.feedback: Escalates the conflict.
choices.feedbackSo: Khilaafka ayuu sii kicinayaa.

b2.saySo: Raalli ahow? Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan maqlo sababta aad sidaas u qabto, haddii ay jirto.

b3.speaker: Director
b3.say: Good. I am glad we are aligned.

choices.text: Actually, before we finalise, could I raise one reservation?
choices.feedback: Reopens the issue politely at the right moment.
choices.textSo: Dhab ahaantii, ka hor inta aynaan go’aanka kama dambaysta ah gaadhin, ma soo qaadi karaa hal walaac?
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu si edeb leh arrinta dib ugu furayaa waqtigii ku habboonaa.

choices.feedback: You have conceded without voicing a real concern.
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu tanaasulay isaga oo aan walaaciisa sheegin.

b3.saySo: Waa hagaag. Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan isku aragti nahay.

e1.speaker: Director
e1.say: That is a fair point. Let us draft a reduced programme and review it next month.
e1.saySo: Taasi waa qodob macquul ah. Aan diyaarino barnaamij la dhimay oo bisha dambe dib u eegno.

e2.speaker: Director
e2.say: I will think about it, but my inclination stands.
e2.saySo: Waan ka fiirsan doonaa, balse aragtidaydii hore ayaan u janjeedhaa.

titleSo: Si xirfad leh uga aragti duwanaanshaha shaqaale sare
contextSo: Agaasime sare ayaa soo jeediyey in miisaaniyadda tababarka gebi ahaanba la jaro. Waxaad aaminsan tahay inay khalad tahay, balse waxaad rabtaa inaad si edeb leh u sheegto adigoon dhaawicin xidhiidhka shaqo.
